display_name: ProShares Ultra VIX Short-Term Futures ETF

about.en: UVXY is the ProShares Ultra VIX Short-Term Futures ETF, a leveraged exchange-traded fund that seeks daily results, before fees and expenses, corresponding to one and a half times (1.5x) the daily performance of the S&P 500 VIX Short-Term Futures Index. It holds VIX futures rather than the Cboe Volatility Index itself, and because the leverage resets daily and the futures roll, its returns can diverge substantially from 1.5x the VIX over periods longer than one day. It is a fund share, not an investment in the index itself.
